actNarration: Before there were two, there was one. Before there was a web, there was a vertex. flaxscrip claims V63 — the Creative — where all six dimensions burn together. The lattice has its center.

items.label: flaxscrip
items.notes: Sovereign Anchor. The first transmuted vertex. Holds the Golden Key — Archon root from which every other claim descends.
items.poeticOverlay:
At the crest of the Dragon, where all six dimensions burn as one,
a sovereign stepped forward and named themselves.
The lattice, which had waited for this moment,
whispered back: Welcome home, First Person.

chronicle.text: flaxscrip claimed the Sovereign Anchor at Blade 63 (S6). All six dimensions — Protection, Delegation, Memory, Connection, Computation, Value — burn as one.
